## The purpose of this document is for week 07 in class activities

**1) Load libraries**

trouble downloading new packages: <https://support.posit.co/hc/en-us/articles/206827897-Secure-Package-Downloads-for-R>

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(maps)
library(mapdata)
library(mapproj)
```

**2) Load in data**

```{r}
# Population in California by county
popdata <- read_csv(here("Week_07", "data", "CApopdata.csv"))

# Seastar counts at field sites in California
stars <- read_csv(here("Week_07", "data", "stars.csv"))
```

**3) Data Analysis**

```{r}
world <- map_data("world")

usa <- map_data("usa")

italy <- map_data("italy")

states <- map_data("state")

counties <- map_data("county")

#map of the world
ggplot()+
  geom_polygon(data = world,
               aes(x= long, y= lat,
                   group = group,
                    fill = region),
               colour = "black") +
  theme_minimal() +
  guides(fill = "none") +
  theme(panel.background = 
          element_rect(fill = "lightblue")) +
  coord_map(projection = "mercator",
            xlim = c(-180, 180))
```

```{r}
CA_data <- states |>
  filter(region == "california")

ggplot()+
  geom_polygon(data = CA_data,
               aes(x= long, y= lat,
                   group = group,
                ),
               colour = "black") +
  theme_dark() +
  guides(fill = "none") +
  labs(title = "State of California")+
  theme(panel.background = 
          element_rect(fill = "green")) + 
  coord_map()

```

```{r}
CApop_county <- popdata |>
  select("subregion"= County, Population) |>
  inner_join(counties) |>
  filter(region =="california")

ggplot()+
  geom_polygon(data = CApop_county,
               aes(x= long, y= lat,
                   group = group,
                   fill = Population),
               colour = "black") +
  geom_point(data = stars,
             aes(x =long, y= lat,
                  size = star_no))+
  coord_map() +
  theme_void()+
  scale_fill_gradient(transform = "log10")+
  labs(size = "# stars / m^2")

ggsave(here("week_07", "outputs", "CApop.pdf"))
  
```

```{r}
library(sf)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(rnaturalearthdata)

world_sf <- ne_countries(scale = "medium",
                         returnclass = "sf")

ggplot(world_sf) +
  geom_sf(fill = "lightgray",
          color = "white") +
  theme_void()
```
